name: Heykel
vibe: The city's meeting point — Atatürk's statue, the bazaar streets, everyone's 'see you at Heykel'

name: Tophane
vibe: Clock tower on the citadel hill, the founders' tombs, the sunset terrace over the whole plain

name: Muradiye
vibe: Ottoman tombs under plane trees, quiet lanes, the old Bursa that never got loud

name: Altıparmak
vibe: Cinemas, cafés and the main avenue between the old city and Çekirge

name: Setbaşı
vibe: The Irgandı bridge and the Gökdere gorge — Yeşil's green mosque up the hill, tea by the water below

name: Çekirge
vibe: Thermal hamams and spa hotels on the hillside, Bursa's classic address

name: Kükürtlü
vibe: Sulphur springs, Kültürpark next door, leafy and residential

name: Nilüfer
vibe: The modern west — malls, wide boulevards, where newcomers rent

name: Özlüce
vibe: Villas and new-build sites, family and expat territory

name: Görükle
vibe: Uludağ University's town — students, cheap food, late nights

name: Mudanya
vibe: Bursa's seafront — the ferry from Istanbul, fish restaurants, a promenade for evenings

name: Tirilye
vibe: Stone houses, olive groves and a fishing harbour — the coast's prettiest village

name: Gemlik
vibe: The olive capital on its own gulf — working port town, beaches beyond it

name: Gölyazı
vibe: A village on an island in Lake Uluabat — pelicans, weeping willows, fish lunch

name: İznik
vibe: Ancient Nicaea on its lake — Roman walls, tile workshops, a slow weekend

name: Cumalıkızık
vibe: Seven-hundred-year-old Ottoman village, cobbled lanes and the famous village breakfast

name: Uludağ
vibe: The mountain — skiing in winter, hiking and cool air in summer, the hotel zone at the top
